verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own background automation. There are per-customer ongoing-monitoring configuration endpoints, plus AI agents for screening/monitoring and transaction monitoring that auto-remediate level-1 alerts and auto-escalate high-risk cases. Asynchronous screening and WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhooks let these flows run unattended. However, the agentic claims are marketing-level, and user-defined automation setup is limited: Starter Plan agent configs cannot be customized, and no general rule or trigger builder is documented. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation rules/triggers beyond monitoring toggles, in-depth docs on configuring the autonomous agents, independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous remediation.
